future_generation_rule: Declare face/species identity and surface/lighting roles separately. Use broad diffuse skin lights with restrained contrast; preserve small eye lights and material-specific metal reflections. Do not fix sheen with blur, flat faces, chalky scratches or extra wrinkle detail.
promotion_rule: All ten new sheets remain provisional. After explicit creator selection, promote only selected sheets/individuals into the normal reference library, link exact files and permitted roles in art direction and manifest, retain rejected or unselected tests outside active references. New species require separate lore confirmation; visual selection alone does not assign culture, alignment or origin.
